name: CrisisFlow
description: Autonomous multi-agent disaster response system. Ingests live crisis signals from USGS, NOAA, GDACS, and NASA EONET, processes them through a 9-agent AI pipeline powered by Google Gemini, allocates humanitarian aid from 6 real UN depots, and self-corrects its own severity assessments using a LoopAgent feedback mechanism.

skills.name: Process Latest Crisis Events
skills.description: Fetches live data from 4 global crisis APIs in parallel, selects the highest-severity active event, runs a 7-stage analysis pipeline (detection, classification, severity scoring, resource allocation, coordination, simulation, storage), then self-corrects the response via a reflection loop until the allocation is appropriate.
examples: What disasters are happening right now?
Allocate humanitarian aid for the current worst crisis.

skills.name: Allocate Humanitarian Aid
skills.description: Delegates to the A2A Logistics Specialist agent (port 8002) to determine optimal aid allocation from 6 UNHRD depots. Selects hubs based on proximity, specialization, and live inventory levels.
examples: Allocate aid for a magnitude 7 earthquake in Nepal.
Which UN hubs should respond to a cyclone in Mozambique?
